question.text: The Investor Charter requires PMs to disclose:

answer.text: Details of related-party transactions and conflict of interest in the Disclosure Document (always available on website)

explanation.text: The Logic: Conflict-of-interest and related-party transactions must be disclosed in DD (publicly available). The Trap: Partial disclosures miss the rule. Cross-Exam Context: Same across XXI-A and III-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Review DD quarterly to refresh conflict-of-interest disclosures.
